scenes.big: How a website form talks to n8n
scenes.say: How does a website form actually talk to n8n? One webhook.

steps: Browser POSTs the form as JSON
scenes.say: When the visitor clicks send, the browser posts the form as JSON to your n8n webhook URL. The webhook node receives it, and the workflow runs.
scenes.caption: Form, then JSON, then Webhook node, then workflow

cards.title: Two URLs, don't mix them up
lines: Test URL: only while you click 'Listen'.
Production URL: only when the workflow is active.

scenes.say: One gotcha: n8n gives you a test URL and a production URL. Put the production URL on the website, and activate the workflow.
scenes.caption: Use the production URL and activate the workflow

scenes.sub: Clinic enquiry AI triage: workflow, setup guide and website form.
scenes.small: Works with n8n Cloud or self-hosted, and any OpenAI-compatible AI.

post.caption:
A website form talks to n8n through one Webhook node: the browser POSTs the form as JSON, the workflow runs.

Most common mistake: pasting the test URL on the live site. Use the production URL and activate the workflow.
